body.statement: Can one attain exact asymptotic minimax constants simultaneously at intersections of the treated-replication, calendar-spacing, and generated-query channels in the rough-Holder frontier?
body.justification: Rate optimality does not identify the joint least-favorable law when multiple nonregular channels bind.
body.gap: The current bounded product experiment supplies comparisons only up to fixed constants.
body.consumer: A sharp solution would calibrate sampling allocation at phase boundaries.
